Order No:-06 Dated:-13-11-2025 Heard the parties.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner seeks permission of this court to withdraw this Criminal Miscellaneous Petition.
Accordingly, this Criminal Miscellaneous Petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
In view of withdrawal of this Criminal Miscellaneous Petition, I.A. No.3027 of 2024 is disposed of being infructuous.

(Anil Kumar Choudhary, J.) Dated:- 13.11.2025 Saroj/
